paras: The ADRO V2 front bumper is designed to refine and modernize the bold look of the G8X M3 and M4.

Compared to our V1 bumper, V2 features more defined air intakes, and a wider, lower appearance. The updated design flows more naturally into the factory headlights and kidney grilles, giving the front end a more balanced and OEM-style look while still standing out from stock.
ft: ADRO Front Bumper V2 for BMW G80 G81 M3 / G82 G83 M4 2020+
